sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: A wandering sorceress of unknown origin. During her travels Nina heard of an ownership dispute between the Empire and the Federation regarding a certain region that was home to some ancient ruins, and felt that such a place must be her true home. While she explored these ruins in search of answers, she came across the Federation general who had captured her once before. As she prepared to take his life as a punishment for his crimes, the ghost of the researcher who had helped her appeared before her. After they exchanged a few words with each other, Nina decided to spare the general and quietly leave the ruins.

|member = |gamedebut = |aliases = |counterpart = Divine Orb Nina |bf2 = true }} '''Nina''' is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. ==In-Game Appearance== ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== A wandering sorceress of unknown origin. During her travels Nina heard of an ownership dispute between the Empire and the Federation regarding a certain region that was home to some ancient ruins, and felt that such a place must be her true home. While she explored these ruins in search of answers, she came across the Federation general who had captured her once before. As she prepared to take his life as a punishment for his crimes, the ghost of the researcher who had helped her appeared before her.
